basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Wellington, New Zealand. I've been a part of the Reddit community for nearly a decade, sharing my passion for RPGs and tech innovations. When I'm not gaming, you can find me working as a software developer or tinkering with my Tesla. I enjoy discussing philosophical topics and strategies on Fantasy Premier League. I'm married with no kids by choice, and my wife shares my love for gaming and tech. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over 15 years in the software development industry, I've honed my expertise in programming, particularly in Python and Java. My knowledge extends to automotive tech, specifically electric vehicles, thanks to my interest in Tesla and personal research. I'm also knowledgeable about gaming strategies and community management from years of active participation in gaming communities.
